differences: Text A lets the spell be cast with flash by paying an additional {2}; Text B makes {5}{W}{W} an alternative cost that replaces the mana cost, which is a different cost of a different amount.
Text B makes the spell castable at instant speed without any extra payment, while Text A allows instant-speed casting only when the extra {2} is paid.

Text A's whole card includes 'Destroy all creatures. They can't be regenerated.' as the spell's effect; Text B gives no such effect, though the instructions require every effect of an instant or sorcery to be given.
